## Library

- `src/index.ts` is the public API: everything consumers may import is exported from it, nothing else is.
- One folder per component: `src/components/<Name>/{<Name>.tsx, <Name>.test.tsx, <Name>.stories.tsx}`.
- `dist/` is build output (published via `files`); never edit or import from it.

agentAppends.prompt: This project is a component library. A new component means: the component in src/components/<Name>/, its test, its Storybook story with a play function, and an export from src/index.ts. Never add app-only code (routing, global state, index.html).
